metadata.description: Gradual for St. Lorenz, Nuremberg (the "Geese Book"), vol. II dated 1510; Gothic notation on five-line staves. The gradual for the Common of Virgins, ff. 192r–192v. Images: Corpus Monodicum (Würzburg IIIF).
metadata.transcription: Corpus Monodicum (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz / Universität Würzburg), document NY 905-II-0192-6TR, https://stagedata.corpus-monodicum.de/mei/b4386715-8f1b-4d90-ade9-42767952a65b/NY%20905-II-0192-6TR.xml (respond) and document NY 905-II-0192-11TR, https://stagedata.corpus-monodicum.de/mei/df8b00fa-3fe6-4705-bae2-8c1e5e8290e0/NY%20905-II-0192-11TR.xml (verse), made with OMMR4all according to Corpus Monodicum's record, corrected against the facsimile for eChant (see corpus-monodicum-corrected/corrections.md). Pitches at the manuscript's level (a fifth above the Graduale Synopticum witnesses), an octave lower than the file.
